rows.title: Section 7.7 gives two different limits for refreshments for public officials, 15 euros and 10 euros.

findings.title: Section 7.7 gives two different limits for refreshments for public officials, 15 euros and 10 euros.
findings.explanation: The first passage allows refreshments worth 15 euros or less per public official at a working meeting. The second passage limits refreshments for a public official to 10 euros per official. Both apply to the same case, refreshments at a working meeting, and no reading makes both amounts the limit at once. An employee who spends 12 euros per official obeys the first passage and breaks the second.
quotes: refreshments worth 15 euros or less for each public official
Refreshments for a public official are limited to 10 euros for each official.
